title: Get Started
content_data:
Welcome to TikTok For Business Developers! With developers in mind, we make accessing and using our API For Business very easy. Only a few simple steps are required to gain access and start managing ads. **Below are the steps needed to take before making your first API call and some useful resources to help you quickly integrate with TikTok API for Business.** # Step-by-step workflow > **Note**
The specific steps required for [authorization](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1781891256601602) and [authentication](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1781892384100354) will vary depending on the type of API you are using. 1. [Create a TikTok For Business account](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738855099573250). 2. [Register as a developer](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738855176671234). 3. [Create a developer app](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738855242728450). 4. [Authorization](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1781891256601602). 5. [Authentication](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1781892384100354). 6. Make your first API call: You can use [TikTok API for Business Postman collection](https://www.postman.com/tiktok/workspace/tiktok-api-for-business/folder/23207567-9c73b718-e802-40f0-a70d-db8524ed2494) to easily **test** your integration without impacting your real TikTok for Business account. > **Note**
You can use either API endpoints or SDK to make your first calls. See [SDK](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1764231376750658) to learn more details. # API endpoints To learn about available endpoints, see [API Reference](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1735713875563521). # SDK To learn about SDK, see [SDK](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1764231376750658). To find the SDK code, check out this [GitHub link](https://github.com/tiktok/tiktok-business-api-sdk). # Rate limits To learn about global and endpoint-specific rate limits, see [here](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1740029171730433). # Update app permissions To learn about how to update your developer app permission, see [here](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738855280338946). # Postman collection To learn about the Postman collection for our API endpoints, see [here](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1747849403155521). # Sandbox accounts To test your integration without impacting your real TikTok For Business account, see [here](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738855331457026). # Concepts To learn about the common concepts used in TikTok API For Business documentation, see [here](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738928364967937). # Account structure To learn about the account structure and the relationships between advertiser accounts and developer accounts, see [here](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1740029179343874). # Estimated Integration time To learn about the estimated integration time needed for some common API integration use cases, see [here](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?rid=7xusz43oh3h&id=1768657234981890). # Error codes To learn about the return codes for unsuccessful calls, see [here](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1737172488964097).
